progression.narrative: The performance opens on F3 and dwells most on Dk in Daramad. The line peaks at F4 (362.4 Hz) at 0:59.1. It closes on Dk4, not the tonic (Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4).
